title: DIG Configuration
description: Persistent configuration for a local DIG install. Lives at $DIG_CONFIG, ~/.config/dig/config.json (Linux + macOS), or <repo>/dig.config.json (dev fallback). All fields optional; missing fields fall back to defaults.

dataDir.description: Where uploads, cached parquet, run outputs, and the metadata SQLite live. Null = <repo>/data/.

logDir.description: Where dig-start.sh writes API + web logs. Null = system tmp dir.

browserPreviewSampleRows.description: Default sample size for in-browser preview when no per-pipeline override is set.
